title: Keep slow source-observation warnings from failing launcher input capture before checks run
outcome: Keep slow source-observation warnings from failing launcher input capture before checks run
acceptance: A real `engram source --json` observation that emits the supported slow-operation warning does not make test-launcher committed-input capture fail before the selected check runs
The source JSON reader still rejects malformed, oversized or otherwise unexpected process output, with regression coverage distinguishing the supported warning from invalid output
The applicable focused launcher check passes on the fix
